newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares close lower amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares close lower amid profit-taking.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed lower on Tuesday as investors booked profits after sharp gains in the previous two sessions, brokers said.
Shares rose in the two previous sessions as rate increases for the telecommunications and electric sectors were announced.
"The market traded down because we had a build up in prices on the rate hikes," said Chris Winter of Banco Geral do Comercio brokerage. "It was a technical correction and profit-taking."
The bolsa's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares ended down 1.0 percent at 9,738 points in moderate trading of shares worth 664.5 million reais ($627.9 million).
